defect: none; an asynchronous reset is asserted immediately and released through a three-register pipeline
rationale: Reset drives all synchronizer stages asserted, and deassertion shifts through one zero per clock. The output therefore cannot release until the full pipeline has observed clock edges.

mutation.description: Reduced verilog-axis sync_reset to a parameterized three-stage reset synchronizer.

provenance.adaptation: Converted the Verilog-2001 module to a self-contained SystemVerilog top with the same reset pipeline.
